# Playbook: unlink
Use when: archive a link, or hide it from agents

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a repository link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> or link id)" |
| level | "project" when the link belongs to one project, else "workspace" | "workspace" |
| projectId | the project that owns a project link | level "project" → STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id)"; else "none" |
| change | "hide" when the user only wants agents to stop seeing it (workspace link; reversible), else "archive" | STOP. Say: "Archive it (no unarchive) or only hide it from agents?" |
| reason | the user's words | "hide" → "none"; else STOP. Say: "Why archive it? (one sentence)" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The link was not changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Archiving or hiding a repository link needs an LPM API key (profile full or custom); this connector cannot do it."
2. IF <input:level> == "project" → go to step 8.
3. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace link; nothing to change."
   IF <input:change> == "hide" → go to step 6.
4. ASK: "Archive workspace link <saved:linkId> (<saved:url>)? Its code index leaves code search and the Advisor at once; there is no unarchive (linking again gives a new id with no index). Reason: <input:reason>. Call: archive_workspace_repository_link(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, reason=<input:reason>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
5. CALL `archive_workspace_repository_link` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","reason":"<input:reason>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has no archivedAt → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is not archived."
   SAVE: outcome = "archived workspace link <saved:linkId> at <archivedAt of that item>"; go to Answer.
6. ASK: "Hide workspace link <saved:linkId> (<saved:url>) from agents (agentVisible false)? Code search, excerpts and the Advisor stop using it at once; playbook change-link makes it visible again. Call: update_workspace_repository_link(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, agentVisible=false) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
7. CALL `update_workspace_repository_link` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","agentVisible":false} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has agentVisible != false → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is still visible to agents."
   SAVE: outcome = "hid workspace link <saved:linkId> (agentVisible false)"; go to Answer.
8. CALL `list_project_repository_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active link in project <input:projectId>; nothing to change."
9. ASK: "Archive project link <saved:linkId> (<saved:url>) of <input:projectId>? There is no unarchive. Reason: <input:reason>. Call: archive_project_repository_link(projectId=<input:projectId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, reason=<input:reason>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
10. CALL `archive_project_repository_link` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","reason":"<input:reason>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_project_repository_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has no archivedAt → STOP. Say: "Project link <saved:linkId> is not archived."
   SAVE: outcome = "archived project link <saved:linkId>"

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (<input:level> link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <<saved:outcome> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <the link list read after the change | none>
Pending: none
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — link archived | none — link hidden; playbook change-link shows it again>
```
Never claim an archive or a hide that the VERIFY above did not list; past scans and index versions are kept.
